patch_list: Remove ads & tracking

Removes every ad (AdMob) and every tracker (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Facebook, TikTok, and the Veridium SDK's own Google Analytics) — event sends, full SDK init (AppsFlyer init, TikTok initializeSdk/startTrack, MobileAds.initialize),…
Unlock daily reward (skip ad)

Claim MyZong's daily reward with no 'watch ad' popup and no ad. Forces the reward-bubble tap to take the app's own direct-claim branch (the same claim call the post-ad path makes), upstream of both the popup and the rewarded ad.

patch_list: Bottom navigation
Configure the bottom bar, tab labels and individual tabs.
Bundles and Usage

Dialogs and drawer

Header
Choose visible header items, titles and replacement shortcuts.
Home account cards
Configure allowance labels, SMS, tariff, recharge and loan controls.
Home sections
Choose which Home sections remain visible and adjust section spacing.
Home shortcuts
Keep only the selected home options. Defaults to Rewards and Rs 100 Shop; no other items are kept automatically.
Launcher icon
Use a rounded Light or Dark ring for the launcher and static startup logo. Leave unselected to keep the original icon.
Material allowance icons
Use Material accent colors on Home and Usage allowance icons.
Material shapes

Material usage favorite star
Use the Material accent for selected Usage and Bundles stars.
Material You theme
Dark Material You colors on Android 12+, with automatic charcoal fallback on older or unsupported devices.
Recharge

Startup
